room_rent.note: Room rent, boarding and nursing expenses capped at 1% of Sum Insured per day

icu.note: ICU/ICCU charges capped at 2% of Sum Insured per day

copayment.note: Mandatory 20% co-payment on every claim; can be waived by paying additional optional premium

sub_limits.note: Cataract capped at ₹40,000 per eye per policy year; Modern treatments capped at 50% of Sum Insured

initial_waiting.note: 30-day initial waiting period for all illnesses except accidents

ped_waiting.note: 24 months for pre-existing disability; 36 months for all other pre-existing conditions (excluding HIV/AIDS which has its own terms)

specific_disease_waiting.note: 20 listed conditions including cataract, hernia, ENT disorders, calculi, varicose veins, etc.

maternity.note: Maternity explicitly excluded under Exclusion Code Excl18

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording

day_care.display: All day-care (indicative list of 537 procedures in Annexure III)

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation expenses explicitly excluded under Exclusion 26

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to 100% of Sum Insured per policy year

organ_donor.note: Hospitalisation for donation of body organs explicitly excluded

ambulance.note: Road ambulance reimbursement capped at ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 listed modern treatments including robotic surgery, oral chemotherapy, stem cell therapy etc., covered up to 50% of Sum Insured

consumables.note: Extensive list of non-payable consumables in Annexure II List I; no optional consumables rider offered

global_cover.note: Any medical treatment taken outside India is explicitly excluded

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, claims cannot be contested except on grounds of fraud

grace_period.note: 30 days for yearly/half-yearly/quarterly premium modes; 15 days for monthly mode

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration

portability.note: Portability to same product of other insurers as per IRDAI guidelines; migration within company also allowed but only on product withdrawal

notable_exclusions: Maternity, domiciliary, organ donor hospitalisation, treatment outside India, ART for HIV, cosmetic/prosthetic devices for disability, STDs, stem cell storage
optional_riders: Co-payment waiver (additional premium to waive mandatory 20% co-pay)
insurer: Cholamandalam MS General Insurance Company Limited
